Read/Write race. Non-private method `ConcurrentSkipListSet.add(...)` indirectly reads without synchronization from `this.currentLevel`, which races with the write in method `ConcurrentSkipListSet.remove(...)`.
 Reporting because the current class is annotated `@ThreadSafe`, so we assume that this method can run in parallel with other non-private methods in the class (including itself).
